sky.qualification: Bebhionn's sky orientation for its camera; the shared universe draws the visible sky.
sky.sceneRegistrationChain: galactic -> ICRF (J2000 constants) -> body-fixed (IAU pole and prime meridian at the epoch) -> ecliptic presentation frame

provenance.source: JPL Saturn-system ephemeris; Physical pole, spin sense and current rotational phase remain unmeasured. The displayed motion does not fit the Cassini lightcurve.
provenance.qualification: Computed Bebhionn Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.
